dfc-b:description:
A whole lamb, between 15-30kg:

2 lamb legs (roasts), can be minced - $20 extra per leg

2 lamb shoulders, can be sausages - $20 extra per shoulder

2 lamb racks 

loin chops

chump chops

2 lamb ribs

2 lamb shanks

neck chops

1 pack of sausages

All leg roasts will be cut in half by default. We can also mince your leg roast. You will be charged a flat fee of $20 for each one as the weight goes considerably.

Please tell us in the checkout notes if you would like it minced or whole.
